Definition: from a presumed prolonged form of G2054; to stimulate (especially to anger):--provoke.
BiblicalUsage: The word erethízō covers to stimulate. It occurs twice, in 2 Corinthians and Colossians.
TheologicalSignificance: I take erethízō as it stands — to stimulate — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
